== Cow's Ironman Guide - Tutorial Island to Max & BIS ==

Last Updated 7/11/26

This guide emphasizes a '''relaxed & AFK-friendly''' path while setting up smooth & early PVM access. Many '''alternatives''' are provided—skip anything you dislike!

It's possible to do this as a Hardcore

All [[Experience lamp]]s on Herblore. Do all [[Random Event]]s

If questing, view it in the '''Quest Helper''' Runelite Plugin and follow the progression
